Subject: RE: Drummond Warehousing Submission

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the Drummond Warehousing submission! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward with quoting.

Just a few quick questions before I finalize terms:

- Can you confirm the primary commodities stored at each location?
- What fire protection systems are in place (sprinklers, alarms, monitoring)?
- Are any locations leased to third parties?
- Any planned renovations or expansions in the next 12 months?

Once I have these details, I'll work up competitive terms for the 12/23/26 effective date. Looking forward to putting something together for you.

Best,
[Underwriter name]
